Which statement is the past perfect of 'No sooner did we leave the house than it began to rain'? No sooner we did leave the house than it began to rain. No sooner we had leave the house than it began to rain. No sooner had we left the house than it begun to rain. No sooner we had leave the house than it begun to rain. Your friend once said, 'The man was sank in the river but it was the boat which wasdrowned in the same river.' You realised the sentence was incorrect. What was hecorrectly supposed to say? The man sank but the boat drowns in the same river. The man was drowned but the boat sank in the same river. The boat drowned but the man sinks in the same river. The boat drowns but the man sinks in the same river. The boat was drowned but the man sank in the same river. Choose Answer : - -
